slo_title: Explain the difference between multithreading and multitasking

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of multithreading in Java?

options.B: Threads run in the same process
options.C: Each thread has its own stack

mcq.q: In a multitasking environment, which of the following statements is true ?

options.A: Tasks must be threads within a single process
options.B: Each task must be in the same address space
options.C: Tasks may run in different address spaces and can be either threads or processes
options.D: Only one task is allowed in memory at a time

mcq.answer_text: Tasks may run in different address spaces and can be either threads or processes

mcq.q: In Java, which of the following best describes the key benefit of concurrent programming?

options.C: Efficient use of CPU resources by running multiple tasks simultaneously

mcq.answer_text: Efficient use of CPU resources by running multiple tasks simultaneously

mcq.q: What happens if two threads access a shared variable without synchronization?

options.A: No issues occur as threads run independently
options.B: The JVM blocks the access automatically
options.C: Data inconsistency or race condition may occur

mcq.answer_text: Data inconsistency or race condition may occur

mcq.q: What is the major difference between process-based multitasking and thread-based multitasking?

options.A: Processes share memory, threads do not
options.B: Threads require more resources than processes
options.C: Processes are independent, threads share memory and resources

mcq.answer_text: Processes are independent, threads share memory and resources

sq.q: Differentiate between preemptive and cooperative multitasking with examples.
answer: Preemptive multitasking allows the OS to interrupt and switch between tasks (e.g., Windows, Linux).
Preemptive multitasking allows the OS to interrupt and switch between tasks (e.g., Windows, Linux).
Cooperative multitasking relies on the running task to yield control (e.g., early Mac OS). Java uses preemptive scheduling via the OS thread scheduler.
Cooperative multitasking relies on the running task to yield control (e.g., early Mac OS). Java uses preemptive scheduling via the OS thread scheduler.

sq.q: Define concurrent programming and explain its importance in modern software development.
answer: Concurrent programming enables multiple computations to run in overlapping time periods—either in parallel or interleaved. It's important in modern software to efficiently use multi-core processors, reduce response time, and enhance application performance.
